voice.text: Is photo ko dhyaan se dekho. Baarish ho rahi hai. Taipei ki ek gali mein ek chhota sa restaurant hai, aur sheeshe ke peeche, ek table par, duniya ki sabse keemti company ka sabse keemti aadmi baitha hai.

Uske saath ek lady hai. Gulabi dress mein. Woh uske kandhe par haath rakhti hai, uske kaan mein kuch kehti hai, aur uske gaal par ek kiss karti hai. Dinner khatam hota hai toh woh aadmi darwaze par ruk kar ek client ko alvida kehta hai — aur woh lady intezaar nahi karti. Woh seedha jaakar uski gaadi mein baith jaati hai.
Us raat Taiwan ki khabar sirf itni thi: Jensen Huang ne baarish mein khade reporters ko fried rice baanta tha.

Dedh saal baad, wahi photo duniya ki sabse badi jaanch ka pehla saboot ban jaayegi. Kyunki America ki intelligence ka kehna hai — yeh lady koi aam businesswoman nahi thi. Yeh China ki jasusi agency ki bheji hui ek agent thi. Aur uska kaam tha — Jensen Huang ke kareeb jaana.
Lekin ruko. Yeh film faisla nahi sunayegi. Yeh film saboot ko ek table par rakhegi — ek-ek karke, ek hi ghadi par — aur tum khud dekhoge: kya sach mein record par hai, aur kya sirf kaha gaya hai.

Is hisse ka connection is kahani se isliye hai kyunki aage jo kuch bhi tum dekhoge — har photo, har kagaz, har aarop — uska wazan inhi chaar khano se tay hoga. Yeh do minute, aage ke athais minute ki neev hain.
